items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in. This vulnerability opens the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension. This flaw, rated 9.8 (critical), can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs, including critical issues like CVE-2026-34686 (Stored XSS leading to arbitrary code execution) and CVE-2026-34653 (Path Traversal leading to arbitrary file system write). Adobe recommends applying the patch within 30 days.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique. Attacks have been observed against a high percentage of stores.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including Stored XSS (CVE-2026-21290, CVE-2026-21361, CVE-2026-21284) and authorization bypass/SSRF issues. Successful exploitation could lead to escalated privileges and unauthorized code execution.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin for Adobe Commerce, Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce Webhooks Plugin
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2024-34102 (CosmicSting), which has been exploited in the wild. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Named 'SessionReaper' by Sansec, this critical bug allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks have hit over 50% of all stores globally.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via server-side template injection (CVE-2025-47110). It also addresses a reflected XSS and a one-click account takeover issue.
